decision: Required to start the Race from the pit lane.
fact: The following Power Unit elements have been used: 4th Energy Store (ES) 4th Control Electronics Unit (PU-CE) 4th MGU-K All Power Unit elements were replaced without the approval of the FIA Technical Delegate during Parc fermé.
offence: Breaches of Article B8.2.2 (read with B8.2.3), B3.5.3 of the FIA F1 Regulations.
penalty: Required to start the Race from the pit lane.
reason: The penalty is imposed in accordance with Article B3.5.3 a. and B8.2.8 of the FIA F1 Regulations. The use of each additional element in this case carries a 10 grid place penalty therefore there is an accumulation of 30 places. Article B2.5.4b.iv of the FIA F1 Regulations provides that a driver which has accrued more than 15 cumulative grid position penalties must start from the back of the grid. As parts of the car were replaced under parc ferme conditions without the approval of the Technical Delegate a pit lane start is mandated in accordance with Article B3.5.3 a.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Infringement Car 14 Pu Elements And Changes Used During Parc Ferme
